_comment: Steps GitHub runs on Pi-Dev-Ops PRs that cannot be reproduced on a macOS laptop. Every entry says why. Keep the list short and the reasons checkable.

exempt.reason: Runs sudo apt-get install postgresql-client; macOS has no apt-get. Every later step in the job uses only psql, which must already be on PATH, so the schema, migration, mesh-schema and RLS assertion steps still run locally against the Docker postgres service.
